title: SHBACE Medical Ultimate Platform module inventory
lifecycle: inventory-only; executable modules are registered by local code and are never remote-loaded

modules.name: Navigation Engine
modules.note: Built-in drawer and remote UI destinations use the shared route adapter; legacy renderers/history remain in place. Physical device route/back/scroll acceptance is still pending.

modules.name: UI Engine
modules.note: Existing renderers remain authoritative; safe nested layouts are now provided by the Page Builder service. The full UI component contract is not yet extracted.

modules.name: Page Builder
modules.note: Android shared renderer supports bounded nested layouts, accessible tabs and accordions, reusable declarative page templates, named slots and fixed allow-listed content-presence conditions. Visual authoring, preview/publish, and real-device acceptance remain future work.

modules.name: Workflow Engine
modules.note: Android v1 supports navigation route-change/render triggers, bounded scalar conditions and an allow-list of navigate/openPage/showMessage actions. Broader app events, rule editor and student-data mutation actions are not implemented.

modules.name: Theme Engine
modules.note: Selected appearance tokens are remote configurable; complete design-token coverage remains.

modules.name: Quiz Engine
modules.note: Existing MCQ flows are preserved; additional interaction types and module adapter remain.

modules.name: Smart Review Engine
modules.note: Local scheduler exists; public scheduler contract and FSRS/SM-2 integration remain.

modules.name: Flashcards Engine
modules.note: Remote viewer and Again/Known state exist; authoring and spaced repetition remain.

modules.name: Medical Bank Engine
modules.note: Substantial banks exist; normalized contracts and content governance adapter remain.

modules.name: Statistics Engine
modules.note: Local statistics exist; shared analytics contracts and configurable reports remain.

modules.name: Media Engine
modules.note: Remote resources exist; complete asset catalog and lifecycle manager remain.

modules.name: Search Engine
modules.note: Question/topic search exists; no unified cross-content index.

modules.name: Data Engine
modules.note: Local stores and backups exist; normalized storage abstraction and migrations remain.

modules.name: Sync Engine
modules.note: Cross-device sync needs backend, authentication and conflict policy.

modules.name: Offline Engine
modules.note: Offline shell and local content packages exist; unified policy remains.

modules.name: Notification Engine
modules.note: Local notifications exist; cloud sender is not verified.

modules.name: AI Engine
modules.note: Prepared AI content and device voice exist; live model service is not connected.

modules.name: Security Engine
modules.note: Allow-list, checksums and validation exist; signed manifest and threat model remain.

modules.name: Update Engine
modules.note: APK release check and content update exist; signed catalog and staged rollout remain.

modules.name: Analytics Engine
modules.note: Consolidated analytics pipeline is not implemented.

modules.name: Admin Console
modules.note: GitHub-backed visual editor and permission gateway are not implemented.

modules.name: User Accounts & Multi-User
modules.note: Requires auth provider, backend, privacy and data-access controls.

modules.name: Gamification Engine
modules.note: Goals/streaks exist; unified achievement engine remains.
